name: Tinkee Steamboil
label: Quest
description: Tinkee Steamboil: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hi, friend. Remember Tinkee Steamboil? Well, she remembers you! She sent me a message to keep an eye out for you, because... She needs your help again. I think it has something to do with her studies on dragons.
You should speak to her in the Burning Steppes, at the Flame Crest.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Felnok was right! I do need your help again, and this time... It's going to be really dangerous.
